kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ينتقد (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِدُ (yantaqidu) /jan.ta.qi.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# يَنْتَقِدَ (yantaqida) /jan.ta.qi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# يَنْتَقِدْ (yantaqid) /jan.ta.qid/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
